body:
Real 3-hop REFLUX chain (REFLUX's first): town.c's town_attempt_convert -> new CAP mod dispatches TOWN_CAPPED -> new ecowar_tick_allcap_win_check polls + asks new ALLCAP mod (pure PARENA win-rule logic) -> dispatches ALLCAP_WIN -> arena_update polls to set the real match winner. No direct call anywhere in the chain. REFLUX extracted into its own standalone packages/reflux/ package since packages/livingmap needed it too. New living_map_bridge_attempt_convert_town is the real entry point a future capture-node card will call. 7 new tests, full suite green (3196 assertions), live-verified via a real match. PARENA commit 4b3694c, ECOWAR commit 316b46c.

⚓ ☃
title: ALLCAP: the win condition itself, made mod-driven
